mapper.select: SELECT G.GOODS_NO, G.GOODS_NM, C.CATE_NM, S.STOCK_QTY FROM TB_GOODS G JOIN TB_CATEGORY C ON G.CATE_CD = C.CATE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_STOCK S ON G.GOODS_NO = S.GOODS_NO <if test="cateCd != null">WHERE G.CATE_CD = #{cateCd}</if>
SELECT I.*, F.FILE_NM FROM TB_GOODS_IMG I JOIN TB_FILE F ON I.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID WHERE I.GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOODS (GOODS_NO, GOODS_NM, CATE_CD, PRICE, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_GOODS.NEXTVAL, #{goodsNm}, #{cateCd}, #{price}, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO TB_GOODS_OPTION (OPT_SN, GOODS_NO, OPT_NM, ADD_PRICE) VALUES (#{optSn}, #{goodsNo}, #{optNm}, #{addPrice})
INSERT INTO TB_STOCK (GOODS_NO, OPT_SN, STOCK_QTY) VALUES (#{goodsNo}, #{optSn}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT CATE_CD, UPPER_CATE_CD, CATE_NM FROM TB_CATEGORY START WITH UPPER_CATE_CD IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR CATE_CD = UPPER_CATE_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CATEGORY (CATE_CD, UPPER_CATE_CD, CATE_NM) VALUES (#{cateCd}, #{upperCateCd}, #{cateNm})
mapper.select: SELECT S.GOODS_NO, G.GOODS_NM, S.STOCK_QTY FROM TB_STOCK S, TB_GOODS G WHERE S.GOODS_NO = G.GOODS_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STOCK SET STOCK_QTY = #{stockQty} WHERE GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} AND OPT_SN = #{optSn}
